messages.content:
The writer's note about it, in their words: Warriors is a series of novels about clans of wild cats. Bluestar, a clan leader, once loved Oakheart of a rival clan; this fic retells her last journey to the Moonstone, where leaders meet the spirits of their ancestors.
A learner of English is rewriting part of a post for AO3 (“Long Way Home”, Chapter 24: The Moonstone):
<<<
I read this fic since the first chapter and the ending made me cry. The scene when Bluestar didn't look back at the camp is staying with me, because she choose to go alone even though she's scared.

* * *

I think it's more about what she find. The journey she did many times, but this time maybe StarClan will tell her Oakheart isn't waiting for her. That's why she makes herself stop thinking of him, I think.
>>>
The part: "The scene when Bluestar didn't look back at the camp is staying with me, because she choose to go alone even though she's scared."
What is wrong with it: 英语读者看到"scared"后通常会期待说明害怕的对象，而这里紧接"go alone"，很容易理解为害怕独自上路。句子没有给出害怕的具体对象，所以读者无法确定作者所指的恐惧，只能再追问。
What they mean (confirmed by them): 她害怕在月石上得知奥克心已不再等她
A version that works (never show it or any stretch of it): "The scene when Bluestar didn't look back at the camp is staying with me, because she chose to go alone even though she was scared of what she'd learn at the Moonstone."
Words they already have as hints: chose, scared, learn, Moonstone, alone, afraid
Their last try: "The scene when Bluestar not look back at the camp is staying with me, because she choose to go alone even she is scared."
What the tutor told them about it: 你的 "even she is scared" 没有说明她怕什么，读者会以为她怕的是独自上路，而你想表达的是她怕到了月石才会得知的事。另外 "not look back" 和 "choose" 的时态也要和前面的过去时对齐。
They are stuck. Write two hints that help them build it themselves, never giving them the wording:
- plan: in Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China), one or two short sentences, as their tutor: how a fluent writer builds this part: what comes first, what follows, how the parts connect (contrast, cause, addition) and where the emphasis goes. Start from their try: what to keep and what to build differently. Name no English word except the hint words above (none from the working version), no letter counts, no fill-in blanks. It is about the words of this part, never the content they talk about ("first the interactions between them, then…" plans a story, not the sentence). When the part is a word or two (left in Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China), or a missing word), say what kind of word goes there and how it sits in the sentence.
- example: one short English sentence a fluent writer would actually write (grammatical and natural on its own), about an everyday topic unrelated to the post (different people, things and events), built the same way as the working version: the same pattern and the same connecting words, none of its other content words. Put [square brackets] around the few words it shares with the working version as they are (the frame they can borrow, at most four), never around the words that change.
The writer may write to you in any language; whatever they write in, everything you write for them is in Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China).
Reply with JSON only: {"plan":"","example":""}

result.text: {"plan":"保留你原句里“因为……所以……”的因果结构，但要把“虽然害怕”单独写成一个完整的让步分句，放在她选择独自上路之后。害怕的具体内容要紧跟在害怕之后作为句尾的重点，并与前面的过去时保持一致。","example":"The guide walked on ahead, [because] he decided to lead the group [even though] he was worried about what the storm would bring."}
